verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own blog post on team comments describes @mentioning teammates and coordinating responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions. However, it is phrased as a generic statement about 'the best email collaboration tools' rather than a concrete description of Superhuman's comment side-thread. The adjacent team features (shared read statuses, reply indicators) do not count toward an internal comment thread. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that Superhuman itself ships comments beside a message, details of how the side-thread and @mention notifications work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around

citations.quote: let you @mention teammates, share live email views, and coordinate responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions
